```{r}

# ============================================================
# 0. Compute Wilcoxon p-values across all 3 CD123 compartments
#    + BH-FDR correction (mirrors the PDL1/xCell approach)
# ============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

compartments_p53 <- c(
  "Positive_cells_tumoral_area",
  "Positive_cells_tumor_stroma",
  "Positive_cells_perivascular_areas"
)

results_p53_cd123 <- lapply(compartments_p53, function(var) {
  test_result <- wilcox.test(
    merged_data[[var]] ~ merged_data$p53_ihc_status
  )
  data.frame(
    compartment = var,
    p_value = test_result$p.value,
    median_Wt = median(merged_data[[var]][merged_data$p53_ihc_status == "Wt"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_Mutant = median(merged_data[[var]][merged_data$p53_ihc_status == "Mutant"], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    FDR_label = paste0("FDR = ", format.pval(FDR, digits = 2, eps = 0.001))
  )

# View corrected results
results_p53_cd123


# ============================================================
# 1. Define colors for p53 status (color-blind–friendly)
# ============================================================

p53_colors_fill <- c(
  "Wt"     = "#41AE76",  # dark green
  "Mutant" = "#79419D"   # dark purple
)

p53_colors_color <- c(
  "Wt"     = "#2B6B4A",  # lighter green for points
  "Mutant" =  "#4F2E6F"  # lighter purple for points
)

# Ensure Wt is first
merged_data$p53_ihc_status <- factor(merged_data$p53_ihc_status,
                                     levels = c("Wt", "Mutant"))


# ============================================================
# 2. Boxplots with nominal p (Wilcoxon) + BH-FDR label
# ============================================================

fdr_tumoral <- results_p53_cd123$FDR_label[results_p53_cd123$compartment == "Positive_cells_tumoral_area"]

ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = p53_ihc_status, y = Positive_cells_tumoral_area, fill = p53_ihc_status)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = p53_ihc_status), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = p53_ihc_status), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.format",
    comparisons = list(c("Wt", "Mutant")),
    label.y = max(merged_data$Positive_cells_tumoral_area) * 1.05
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(merged_data$Positive_cells_tumoral_area) * 1.15,
           label = fdr_tumoral, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = p53_colors_fill) +
  scale_color_manual(values = p53_colors_color) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "p53 IHC Status",
    y = "Fraction",
    title = "Fraction by p53 Mutation Status with Wilcoxon Test_Tumor area"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")



fdr_stroma <- results_p53_cd123$FDR_label[results_p53_cd123$compartment == "Positive_cells_tumor_stroma"]

ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = p53_ihc_status, y = Positive_cells_tumor_stroma, fill = p53_ihc_status)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = p53_ihc_status), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = p53_ihc_status), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.format",
    comparisons = list(c("Wt", "Mutant")),
    label.y = max(merged_data$Positive_cells_tumor_stroma) * 1.05
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(merged_data$Positive_cells_tumor_stroma) * 1.15,
           label = fdr_stroma, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = p53_colors_fill) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "p53 IHC Status",

    title = "Positive cells in tumor_stroma by p53 Mutation Status"

fdr_perivasc <- results_p53_cd123$FDR_label[results_p53_cd123$compartment == "Positive_cells_perivascular_areas"]
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SHARED HELPERS
# ============================================================================

check_convergence <- function(model, maxit_val) {
  n_iter <- model$iter
  !is.null(n_iter) &&
    all(n_iter < maxit_val) &&
    is.finite(sum(model$coefficients))
}

find_maxstat_cutoff_ihc <- function(time_var, event_var, marker_var, data) {
  d <- data[!is.na(data[[marker_var]]) & !is.na(data[[time_var]]) & !is.na(data[[event_var]]), ]
  n <- nrow(d)
  if (n < 10) return(NA_real_)

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("survival::Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", marker_var))
  MAXSTAT <- tryCatch(
    maxstat::maxstat.test(fmla, data = d, smethod = "LogRank", pmethod = "Lau92",
                           iscores = TRUE, minprop = 0.2, maxprop = 0.8),
    error = function(e) NA
  )
  if (isTRUE(is.na(MAXSTAT))) return(NA_real_)
  MAXSTAT$estimate
}

add_threshold_groups_ihc <- function(df, time_var, event_var, marker_var) {
  cutoff_maxstat <- tryCatch(
    find_maxstat_cutoff_ihc(time_var, event_var, marker_var, df),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  cutoff_median <- median(df[[marker_var]], na.rm = TRUE)

  df %>%
    mutate(
      Group_maxstat = ifelse(!is.na(cutoff_maxstat) & .data[[marker_var]] > cutoff_maxstat,
                              "High", "Low"),
      Group_median  = ifelse(.data[[marker_var]] > cutoff_median, "High", "Low")
    )
}


make_cutoff_table_ihc <- function(data, markers, time_var, event_var) {
  bind_rows(lapply(markers, function(m) {
    d  <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[m]]), !is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]))
    ev <- as.numeric(as.character(d[[event_var]]))
  cuts <- c(maxstat = unname(find_maxstat_cutoff_ihc(time_var, event_var, m, d)),
              median  = median(d[[m]], na.rm = TRUE))
    bind_rows(lapply(names(cuts), function(tt) {
      high <- !is.na(cuts[[tt]]) & d[[m]] > cuts[[tt]]
      data.frame(marker = m, threshold_type = tt,
                 cutoff = signif(cuts[[tt]], 3),
                 `n (Low/High)`      = paste0(sum(!high), "/", sum(high)),
                 `Events (Low/High)` = paste0(sum(ev[!high] == 1), "/", sum(ev[high] == 1)),
                 check.names = FALSE)
    }))
  }))
}

add_cutoffs_ihc <- function(tab, cutoff_table) {
  tab <- tab %>%
    left_join(cutoff_table, by = c("marker", "threshold_type")) %>%
    relocate(cutoff, `n (Low/High)`, `Events (Low/High)`, .after = threshold_type)
  if ("Variable" %in% names(tab)) {
    keep <- grepl("^Enrichment", tab$Variable)
    tab[!keep, c("cutoff", "n (Low/High)", "Events (Low/High)")] <- NA
  }
  tab$converged <- ifelse(tab$converged, "Yes", "No")
  tab
}

covariates_full <- c("figo_ini_ava", "p53_ihc_status")

compartments <- c(
  "Positive_cells_tumoral_area",
  "Positive_cells_tumor_stroma",
  "Positive_cells_perivascular_areas"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# DSS -- UNIVARIATE
# ============================================================================

run_cox_DSS_ihc_group <- function(marker_label, marker_var, exposure_var, threshold_label,
                                   data, maxit_val = 100000) {

  df0 <- add_threshold_groups_ihc(data, "time_death_surv_60m", "death_disease_60m", marker_var)
  df0[[exposure_var]] <- relevel(factor(df0[[exposure_var]]), ref = "Low")
  df0 <- df0 %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[exposure_var]]), !is.na(death_disease_60m), !is.na(time_death_surv_60m))

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ", exposure_var))

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      marker = marker_label, threshold_type = threshold_label,
      coef = NA, HR = NA, lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  s <- summary(model)
  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_label, threshold_type = threshold_label,
    coef = s$coefficients, HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower, upper_095 = s$ci.upper, pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged
  )
}

run_cox_DSS_ihc_continuous <- function(marker_label, marker_var, data, maxit_val = 100000) {

  df0 <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[marker_var]]), !is.na(death_disease_60m), !is.na(time_death_surv_60m))

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ", marker_var))

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      marker = marker_label, threshold_type = "continuous",
      coef = NA, HR = NA, lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  s <- summary(model)
  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_label, threshold_type = "continuous",
    coef = s$coefficients, HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower, upper_095 = s$ci.upper, pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged
  )
}

univ_DSS_maxstat_ihc <- bind_rows(
  lapply(compartments, function(marker) {
    run_cox_DSS_ihc_group(marker, marker, "Group_maxstat", "maxstat", ihc_data)
  })
)

univ_DSS_median_ihc <- bind_rows(
  lapply(compartments, function(marker) {
    run_cox_DSS_ihc_group(marker, marker, "Group_median", "median", ihc_data)
  })

univ_DSS_continuous_ihc <- bind_rows(
  lapply(compartments, function(marker) {
    run_cox_DSS_ihc_continuous(marker, marker, ihc_data)
  })
)

univ_DSS_ihc_all <- bind_rows(univ_DSS_maxstat_ihc, univ_DSS_median_ihc, univ_DSS_continuous_ihc) %>%
  group_by(threshold_type) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

univ_DSS_ihc_formatted <- univ_DSS_ihc_all %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f\u2013%.3f)", HR, lower_095, upper_095),
    pval = round(pval, 4),
    p_adj_BH = round(p_adj_BH, 4)
  ) %>%
  select(marker, threshold_type, HR_CI, pval, p_adj_BH, n, n_events, n_iter, converged) %>%
  arrange(marker, threshold_type)

cutoffs_DSS_cd123 <- make_cutoff_table_ihc(ihc_data, compartments,
                                           "time_death_surv_60m", "death_disease_60m")
cutoffs_DSS_cd123

univ_DSS_ihc_formatted <- add_cutoffs_ihc(univ_DSS_ihc_formatted, cutoffs_DSS_cd123)
kable(univ_DSS_ihc_formatted)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# DSS -- MULTIVARIATE MAXSTAT / MEDIAN
# adjusted for FIGO + p53
# ============================================================================

perform_cox_DSS_ihc_multiv <- function(marker_label, marker_var, exposure_var,
                                        data, covariates, maxit_val = 100000) {

  df0 <- add_threshold_groups_ihc(data, "time_death_surv_60m", "death_disease_60m", marker_var)
  df0[[exposure_var]] <- relevel(factor(df0[[exposure_var]]), ref = "Low")

  df0 <- df0 %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[exposure_var]]), !is.na(death_disease_60m), !is.na(time_death_surv_60m),
           if_all(all_of(covariates), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    droplevels()

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ",
    paste(c(exposure_var, covariates), collapse = " + ")
  ))

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      marker = marker_label, variable = NA_character_, coef = NA_real_, HR = NA_real_,
      lower_095 = NA_real_, upper_095 = NA_real_, pval = NA_real_,
      n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_label,
    variable = names(model$coefficients),
    coef = as.numeric(model$coefficients), HR = exp(as.numeric(model$coefficients)),
    lower_095 = as.numeric(model$ci.lower), upper_095 = as.numeric(model$ci.upper),
    pval = as.numeric(model$prob),
    n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


multiv_DSS_maxstat_ihc <- if (length(selected_DSS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(selected_DSS_ihc, function(marker) {
    perform_cox_DSS_ihc_multiv(marker, marker, "Group_maxstat", ihc_data, covariates_full)
  }))
} else data.frame()

if (nrow(multiv_DSS_maxstat_ihc) > 0) {

  marker_rows <- grepl("^Group_maxstat", multiv_DSS_maxstat_ihc$variable)
  multiv_DSS_maxstat_ihc$p_adj_BH[marker_rows] <- p.adjust(
    multiv_DSS_maxstat_ihc$pval[marker_rows], method = "BH"
  )
}


multiv_DSS_median_ihc <- if (length(selected_DSS_ihc) > 0) {

    perform_cox_DSS_ihc_multiv(marker, marker, "Group_median", ihc_data, covariates_full)

} else data.frame()

if (nrow(multiv_DSS_median_ihc) > 0) {

perform_cox_DSS_ihc_multiv_continuous <- function(marker_label, marker_var,
                                                    data, covariates, maxit_val = 100000) {

  df0 <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[marker_var]]), !is.na(death_disease_60m), !is.na(time_death_surv_60m),
           if_all(all_of(covariates), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    droplevels()

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ",
    paste(c(marker_var, covariates), collapse = " + ")
  ))

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      marker = marker_label, variable = NA_character_, coef = NA_real_, HR = NA_real_,
      lower_095 = NA_real_, upper_095 = NA_real_, pval = NA_real_,
      n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_label,
    variable = names(model$coefficients),
    coef = as.numeric(model$coefficients), HR = exp(as.numeric(model$coefficients)),
    lower_095 = as.numeric(model$ci.lower), upper_095 = as.numeric(model$ci.upper),
    pval = as.numeric(model$prob),
    n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc <- if (length(selected_DSS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(selected_DSS_ihc, function(marker) {
    perform_cox_DSS_ihc_multiv_continuous(marker, marker, ihc_data, covariates_full)
  }))
} else data.frame()

if (nrow(multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc) > 0) {
  multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc <- multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc %>% mutate(p_adj_BH = NA_real_)
  marker_rows <- multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc$variable == multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc$marker
  multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc$p_adj_BH[marker_rows] <- p.adjust(
    multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc$pval[marker_rows], method = "BH"
  )
}

multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc <- multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc %>%
  mutate(threshold_type = "continuous", .after = marker)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine maxstat + median + continuous
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

multiv_DSS_ihc_all <- bind_rows(
  multiv_DSS_maxstat_ihc,
  multiv_DSS_median_ihc,
  multiv_DSS_continuous_ihc
)

format_table_DSS_ihc <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      variable_label = case_when(
        grepl("^Group_", variable) ~ "Enrichment (High vs Low)",
        variable == marker ~ "Continuous (per unit)",
        variable == "figo_ini_ava0 (Initial)" ~ "FIGO (Initial)",
        variable == "p53_ihc_statusWt" ~ "p53 (Normal)",
        TRUE ~ variable
      ),
      HR_CI = sprintf("%.4f (%.4f\u2013%.4f)", HR, lower_095, upper_095),
      coef = round(coef, 4), pval = round(pval, 4), p_adj_BH = round(p_adj_BH, 4)
    ) %>%
    select(marker, threshold_type, Variable = variable_label, Coef = coef,
           `HR (95% CI)` = HR_CI, `p-value` = pval, `p (BH-adj)` = p_adj_BH,
           n, n_events, n_iter, converged)
}

multiv_DSS_ihc_formatted <- format_table_DSS_ihc(multiv_DSS_ihc_all) %>%
  arrange(marker, threshold_type)


multiv_DSS_ihc_formatted <- add_cutoffs_ihc(multiv_DSS_ihc_formatted, cutoffs_DSS_cd123)

kable(multiv_DSS_ihc_formatted, caption = "Multivariate Firth Cox regression for DSS: CD123 IHC")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# DSS -- PROPORTIONAL HAZARDS ASSUMPTION
# ============================================================================

check_ph_DSS_ihc <- function(marker_label, marker_var, data, exposure_var, covariates) {

  df0 <- add_threshold_groups_ihc(data, "time_death_surv_60m", "death_disease_60m", marker_var)
  df0[[exposure_var]] <- relevel(factor(df0[[exposure_var]]), ref = "Low")

  d <- df0 %>%
    mutate(death_disease_60m = as.numeric(as.character(death_disease_60m))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[exposure_var]]), !is.na(figo_ini_ava), !is.na(p53_ihc_status)) %>%
    droplevels()

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ",
    paste(c(exposure_var, covariates), collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(fmla, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_label, term = NA, chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA,
                       global_p = NA, note = "coxph_fit_failed"))
  }

  zph <- tryCatch(cox.zph(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(zph)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_label, term = NA, chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA,
                       global_p = NA, note = "zph_failed"))
  }

  tab <- as.data.frame(zph$table)
  tab$term <- rownames(tab)
  global_p <- tab$p[tab$term == "GLOBAL"]

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_label, term = tab$term, chisq = round(tab$chisq, 3), df = tab$df,
    p = round(tab$p, 4), global_p = round(global_p, 4), note = NA_character_
  )
}


check_ph_DSS_ihc_continuous <- function(marker_label, marker_var, data, covariates) {

  d <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[marker_var]]), !is.na(time_death_surv_60m), !is.na(death_disease_60m),
           if_all(all_of(covariates), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    mutate(death_disease_60m = as.numeric(as.character(death_disease_60m))) %>%
    droplevels()

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ",
    marker_var, " + ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(fmla, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_label, term = NA, chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA,
                       global_p = NA, note = "coxph_fit_failed"))
  }

  zph <- tryCatch(cox.zph(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(zph)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_label, term = NA, chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA,
                       global_p = NA, note = "zph_failed"))
  }

  tab <- as.data.frame(zph$table)
  tab$term <- rownames(tab)
  global_p <- tab$p[tab$term == "GLOBAL"]

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_label, term = tab$term, chisq = round(tab$chisq, 3), df = tab$df,
    p = round(tab$p, 4), global_p = round(global_p, 4), note = NA_character_
  )
}

ph_DSS_maxstat_ihc <- if (length(selected_DSS_ihc) > 0) {
```

```{r}
get_cutoff_DSS_ihc <- function(threshold_type, marker_var, data) {
  if (threshold_type == "maxstat") {
    find_maxstat_cutoff_ihc("time_death_surv_60m", "death_disease_60m", marker_var, data)
  } else {
    median(data[[marker_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

bootstrap_cutoff_DSS_ihc <- function(marker_val,
                                      threshold_type,
                                      data,
                                      covariates,
                                      B = 1000,
                                      maxit_boot = 500,
                                      maxstep_boot = 0.5,
                                      seed = 1) {

  t0 <- Sys.time()

  df0 <- data[!is.na(data[[marker_val]]) &
                !is.na(data$time_death_surv_60m) &
                !is.na(data$death_disease_60m), ]

  cutoff0 <- get_cutoff_DSS_ihc(threshold_type, marker_val, df0)
  if (is.na(cutoff0)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
                       HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
                       HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
                       pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "cutoff_not_found"))
  }

  df0$Group <- factor(ifelse(df0[[marker_val]] > cutoff0, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High"))
  if (nlevels(droplevels(df0$Group)) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
                       HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
                       HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
                       pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "single_group"))
  }

  fmla_boot <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ Group + ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit_apparent <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = 100000, pl = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_apparent) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_apparent$coefficients))) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
                       HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
                       HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
                       pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "apparent_fit_failed"))
  }

  beta_apparent <- unname(fit_apparent$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(df0)
  optimism_vec <- rep(NA_real_, B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(n), n, replace = TRUE)
    dboot <- df0[idx, ]

    cutoff_b <- get_cutoff_DSS_ihc(threshold_type, marker_val, dboot)
    if (is.na(cutoff_b)) next

    dboot$Group <- factor(ifelse(dboot[[marker_val]] > cutoff_b, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High"))
    if (nlevels(droplevels(dboot$Group)) < 2) next
    ev_tab_boot <- table(dboot$Group, dboot$death_disease_60m)
    if (ncol(ev_tab_boot) < 2 || any(ev_tab_boot[, 2] == 0)) next

    fit_boot <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = dboot, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_boot) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_boot$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_apparent <- unname(fit_boot$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

    df_test <- df0
    df_test$Group <- factor(ifelse(df_test[[marker_val]] > cutoff_b, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High"))
    if (nlevels(droplevels(df_test$Group)) < 2) next
    ev_tab_test <- table(df_test$Group, df_test$death_disease_60m)
    if (ncol(ev_tab_test) < 2 || any(ev_tab_test[, 2] == 0)) next

    fit_test <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df_test, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_test) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_test$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_test <- unname(fit_test$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

    optimism_vec[b] <- beta_boot_apparent - beta_boot_test
  }

  valid_optimism <- optimism_vec[!is.na(optimism_vec)]
  n_valid <- length(valid_optimism)
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  if (n_valid < max(10, 0.2 * B)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
                       HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = NA,
                       HR_corrected_lower = NA, HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA,
                       B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid, pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1),
                       elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1), error = "too_few_valid_bootstraps"))
  }

  mean_optimism <- mean(valid_optimism)
  beta_corrected <- beta_apparent - mean_optimism
  corrected_dist <- beta_apparent - valid_optimism
  ci <- quantile(corrected_dist, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
    HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = exp(beta_corrected),
    HR_corrected_lower = exp(ci[1]), HR_corrected_upper = exp(ci[2]),
    optimism = mean_optimism, B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid,
    pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1), elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1), error = NA_character_
  )
}

# Only markers where the enrichment term reached p.adj<0.05 in the apparent model,
# both thresholds bootstrapped for comparison -- same rule as xCell

boot_DSS_ihc_maxstat <- if (length(sig_maxstat_DSS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(sig_maxstat_DSS_ihc, bootstrap_cutoff_DSS_ihc,
                    threshold_type = "maxstat", data = ihc_data,
                    covariates = covariates_full, B = 1000))
} else data.frame()

boot_DSS_ihc_median <- if (length(sig_median_DSS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(sig_median_DSS_ihc, bootstrap_cutoff_DSS_ihc,
                    threshold_type = "median", data = ihc_data,
                    covariates = covariates_full, B = 1000))
} else data.frame()

```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# CONTINUOUS DSS BOOTSTRAP
# ============================================================================

bootstrap_continuous_DSS_ihc <- function(marker_val,
                                         data,
                                         covariates,
                                         B = 1000,
                                         maxit_boot = 500,
                                         maxstep_boot = 0.5,
                                         seed = 1) {

  t0 <- Sys.time()

  df0 <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[marker_val]]),
      !is.na(time_death_surv_60m),
      !is.na(death_disease_60m),
      if_all(all_of(covariates), ~ !is.na(.))
    ) %>%
    droplevels()

  fmla_boot <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ", marker_val, " + ",
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit_apparent <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = 100000, pl = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_apparent) || !(marker_val %in% names(fit_apparent$coefficients))) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
                       HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
                       HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
                       pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "apparent_fit_failed"))
  }

  beta_apparent <- unname(fit_apparent$coefficients[marker_val])

  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(df0)
  optimism_vec <- rep(NA_real_, B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(n), n, replace = TRUE)
    dboot <- df0[idx, ]

    fit_boot <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = dboot, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_boot) || !(marker_val %in% names(fit_boot$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_apparent <- unname(fit_boot$coefficients[marker_val])

    fit_test <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_test) || !(marker_val %in% names(fit_test$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_test <- unname(fit_test$coefficients[marker_val])

    optimism_vec[b] <- beta_boot_apparent - beta_boot_test
  }

  valid_optimism <- optimism_vec[!is.na(optimism_vec)]
  n_valid <- length(valid_optimism)
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  if (n_valid < max(10, 0.2 * B)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
                       HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = NA,
                       HR_corrected_lower = NA, HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA,
                       B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid, pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1),
                       elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1), error = "too_few_valid_bootstraps"))
  }

  mean_optimism <- mean(valid_optimism)
  beta_corrected <- beta_apparent - mean_optimism
  corrected_dist <- beta_apparent - valid_optimism
  ci <- quantile(corrected_dist, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
    HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = exp(beta_corrected),
    HR_corrected_lower = exp(ci[1]), HR_corrected_upper = exp(ci[2]),
    optimism = mean_optimism, B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid,
    pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1), elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1),
    error = NA_character_
  )
}

boot_DSS_ihc_continuous <- if (length(sig_continuous_DSS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(sig_continuous_DSS_ihc, bootstrap_continuous_DSS_ihc,
                    data = ihc_data, covariates = covariates_full, B = 1000))
} else data.frame()

boot_DSS_ihc_all <- bind_rows(boot_DSS_ihc_maxstat, boot_DSS_ihc_median, boot_DSS_ihc_continuous) %>%
  arrange(marker, threshold_type)

kable(boot_DSS_ihc_all, caption = "Bootstrap optimism correction for multivariable DSS models: CD123 IHC")
```

#Visualitzation
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Shared helper: builds a sensible plotting order from whatever markers are
# actually present, instead of a hardcoded vector. Mirrors build_cell_type_order()
# from the xCell script, renamed for markers. Defined once here; reused as-is
# in the RFS-IHC visualization block below.
# ============================================================================

build_marker_order <- function(markers) {
  markers <- unique(markers)
  is_score <- grepl("score", markers, ignore.case = TRUE)
  ordered <- c(sort(markers[is_score]), sort(markers[!is_score]))
  rev(ordered)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# FOREST PLOT -- DSS (CD123 IHC), maxstat vs. median, bootstrap-corrected HRs
# ============================================================================

library(ggplot2)

make_optimism_forest_ihc <- function(boot_df, multiv_df, title) {

  sig_df <- multiv_df %>%
    filter(Variable == "Enrichment (High vs Low)") %>%
    transmute(marker, threshold_type,
              significant = !is.na(`p (BH-adj)`) & `p (BH-adj)` < 0.05)

  df <- boot_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(HR_corrected), threshold_type %in% c("maxstat", "median")) %>%
    left_join(sig_df, by = c("marker", "threshold_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      significant = ifelse(is.na(significant), FALSE, significant),
      threshold_type = factor(threshold_type, levels = c("maxstat", "median"),
                               labels = c("Maxstat", "Median"))
    )

  marker_order <- build_marker_order(df$marker)
  df <- df %>% mutate(marker = factor(marker, levels = marker_order))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = marker, y = HR_corrected, color = threshold_type,
                  shape = significant)) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = HR_corrected_lower, ymax = HR_corrected_upper),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Maxstat" = "#D55E00", "Median" = "#0072B2"),
                        name = "Threshold") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1),
                        labels = c("TRUE" = "p.adj < 0.05", "FALSE" = "n.s."),
                        name = "Significance\n(apparent model)") +
    labs(title = title, x = "", y = "Bootstrap-corrected Hazard Ratio (log scale)") +
    theme_minimal()
}

  boot_DSS_ihc_all, multiv_DSS_ihc_formatted,
  "DSS \u2014 CD123 IHC, bootstrap-corrected HRs, maxstat vs. median"
)
forest_DSS_ihc_corrected
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
```

#kaplan meiers
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# KAPLAN-MEIER -- DSS by CD123 enrichment (maxstat and median)
# Mirrors plot_km() from the xCell script. Unlike the xCell version, this
# does NOT need to run before the RFS section, because add_threshold_groups_ihc()
# recomputes Group_maxstat/Group_median fresh on every call rather than relying
# on columns pre-attached to a shared analysis_data -- no ordering dependency.
# ============================================================================

plot_km_ihc <- function(data, marker_var, time_var, event_var, group_var, title) {

  df0 <- add_threshold_groups_ihc(data, time_var, event_var, marker_var)
  df0[[event_var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df0[[event_var]]))
  df0[[group_var]] <- droplevels(factor(df0[[group_var]], levels = c("Low", "High")))
  df0 <- df0 %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]))

  grp_counts <- table(df0[[group_var]])
  if (any(grp_counts == 0) || length(grp_counts) < 2) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Cannot build KM plot for '%s' / %s: group counts are %s.",
      marker_var, group_var, paste(names(grp_counts), grp_counts, sep = "=", collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var))
  fit <- survminer::surv_fit(fmla, data = df0)

  ggsurvplot(
    fit, data = df0, pval = TRUE, risk.table = TRUE,
    legend.title = paste(marker_var, "enrichment"), legend.labs = c("Low", "High"),
    title = title, palette = c("gray50", "black"),
    xlab = "Time (months)", ylab = "Survival probability"
  )
}

# One KM pair per marker that reached significance in the apparent multivariate
# model (mirrors using "Plasmacytoid dendritic cell" as the single significant
# xCell hit; here there may be more than one CD123 compartment).

})
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# RFS (RECURRENCE) -- CD123 IHC
# ============================================================================

run_cox_RFS_ihc_group <- function(marker_label, marker_var, exposure_var, threshold_label,
                                   data, maxit_val = 100000) {

  df0 <- add_threshold_groups_ihc(data, "time_recurrence_surv_60m", "recurrence_60m", marker_var)
  df0[[exposure_var]] <- relevel(factor(df0[[exposure_var]]), ref = "Low")
  df0 <- df0 %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[exposure_var]]), !is.na(recurrence_60m), !is.na(time_recurrence_surv_60m))

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ", exposure_var))

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      marker = marker_label, threshold_type = threshold_label,
      coef = NA, HR = NA, lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  s <- summary(model)
  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_label, threshold_type = threshold_label,
    coef = s$coefficients, HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower, upper_095 = s$ci.upper, pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged
  )
}

run_cox_RFS_ihc_continuous <- function(marker_label, marker_var, data, maxit_val = 100000) {

  df0 <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[marker_var]]), !is.na(recurrence_60m), !is.na(time_recurrence_surv_60m))

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ", marker_var))

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      marker = marker_label, threshold_type = "continuous",
      coef = NA, HR = NA, lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  s <- summary(model)
  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_label, threshold_type = "continuous",
    coef = s$coefficients, HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower, upper_095 = s$ci.upper, pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df0), n_events = sum(df0$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged
  )
}

univ_RFS_maxstat_ihc <- bind_rows(
  lapply(compartments, function(m) run_cox_RFS_ihc_group(m, m, "Group_maxstat", "maxstat", ihc_data))
)
univ_RFS_median_ihc <- bind_rows(
  lapply(compartments, function(m) run_cox_RFS_ihc_group(m, m, "Group_median", "median", ihc_data))
)
univ_RFS_continuous_ihc <- bind_rows(
  lapply(compartments, function(m) run_cox_RFS_ihc_continuous(m, m, ihc_data))
)

univ_RFS_ihc_all <- bind_rows(univ_RFS_maxstat_ihc, univ_RFS_median_ihc, univ_RFS_continuous_ihc) %>%
  group_by(threshold_type) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

univ_RFS_ihc_formatted <- univ_RFS_ihc_all %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f\u2013%.3f)", HR, lower_095, upper_095),
    pval = round(pval, 4), p_adj_BH = round(p_adj_BH, 4)
  ) %>%
  select(marker, threshold_type, HR_CI, pval, p_adj_BH, n, n_events, n_iter, converged) %>%
  arrange(marker, threshold_type)

cutoffs_RFS_cd123 <- make_cutoff_table_ihc(ihc_data, compartments,

univ_RFS_ihc_formatted <- add_cutoffs_ihc(univ_RFS_ihc_formatted, cutoffs_RFS_cd123)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# RFS BOOTSTRAP FUNCTIONS 
# ============================================================================

get_cutoff_RFS_ihc <- function(threshold_type, marker_var, data) {
  if (threshold_type == "maxstat") {
    find_maxstat_cutoff_ihc("time_recurrence_surv_60m", "recurrence_60m", marker_var, data)
  } else {
    median(data[[marker_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

bootstrap_cutoff_RFS_ihc <- function(marker_val,
                                     threshold_type,
                                     data,
                                     covariates,
                                     B = 1000,
                                     maxit_boot = 500,
                                     maxstep_boot = 0.5,
                                     seed = 1) {

  t0 <- Sys.time()

  df0 <- data[
    !is.na(data[[marker_val]]) &
      !is.na(data$time_recurrence_surv_60m) &
      !is.na(data$recurrence_60m),
  ]

  cutoff0 <- get_cutoff_RFS_ihc(threshold_type, marker_val, df0)
  if (is.na(cutoff0)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
                       HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
                       HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
                       pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "cutoff_not_found"))
  }

  df0$Group <- factor(ifelse(df0[[marker_val]] > cutoff0, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High"))
  if (nlevels(droplevels(df0$Group)) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
                       HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
                       HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
                       pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "single_group"))
  }

  fmla_boot <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ Group + ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit_apparent <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = 100000, pl = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_apparent) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_apparent$coefficients))) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
                       HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
                       HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
                       pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "apparent_fit_failed"))
  }

  beta_apparent <- unname(fit_apparent$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(df0)
  optimism_vec <- rep(NA_real_, B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(n), n, replace = TRUE)
    dboot <- df0[idx, ]

    cutoff_b <- get_cutoff_RFS_ihc(threshold_type, marker_val, dboot)
    if (is.na(cutoff_b)) next

    dboot$Group <- factor(ifelse(dboot[[marker_val]] > cutoff_b, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High"))
    if (nlevels(droplevels(dboot$Group)) < 2) next
    ev_tab_boot <- table(dboot$Group, dboot$recurrence_60m)
    if (ncol(ev_tab_boot) < 2 || any(ev_tab_boot[, 2] == 0)) next

    fit_boot <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = dboot, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_boot) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_boot$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_apparent <- unname(fit_boot$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

    df_test <- df0
    df_test$Group <- factor(ifelse(df_test[[marker_val]] > cutoff_b, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High"))
    if (nlevels(droplevels(df_test$Group)) < 2) next
    ev_tab_test <- table(df_test$Group, df_test$recurrence_60m)
    if (ncol(ev_tab_test) < 2 || any(ev_tab_test[, 2] == 0)) next

    fit_test <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df_test, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_test) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_test$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_test <- unname(fit_test$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

    optimism_vec[b] <- beta_boot_apparent - beta_boot_test
  }

  valid_optimism <- optimism_vec[!is.na(optimism_vec)]
  n_valid <- length(valid_optimism)
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  if (n_valid < max(10, 0.2 * B)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
                       HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = NA,
                       HR_corrected_lower = NA, HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA,
                       B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid, pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1),
                       elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1), error = "too_few_valid_bootstraps"))
  }

  mean_optimism <- mean(valid_optimism)
  beta_corrected <- beta_apparent - mean_optimism
  corrected_dist <- beta_apparent - valid_optimism
  ci <- quantile(corrected_dist, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
    HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = exp(beta_corrected),
    HR_corrected_lower = exp(ci[1]), HR_corrected_upper = exp(ci[2]),
    optimism = mean_optimism, B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid,
    pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1), elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1),
    error = NA_character_
  )
}

boot_RFS_ihc_maxstat <- if (length(sig_maxstat_RFS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(sig_maxstat_RFS_ihc, bootstrap_cutoff_RFS_ihc,
                    threshold_type = "maxstat", data = ihc_data,
                    covariates = covariates_full, B = 1000))
} else data.frame()

boot_RFS_ihc_median <- if (length(sig_median_RFS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(sig_median_RFS_ihc, bootstrap_cutoff_RFS_ihc,
                    threshold_type = "median", data = ihc_data,
                    covariates = covariates_full, B = 1000))
} else data.frame()
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# CONTINUOUS RFS BOOTSTRAP
# ============================================================================

bootstrap_continuous_RFS_ihc <- function(marker_val,
                                         data,
                                         covariates,
                                         B = 1000,
                                         maxit_boot = 500,
                                         maxstep_boot = 0.5,
                                         seed = 1) {

  t0 <- Sys.time()

  df0 <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[marker_val]]),
      !is.na(time_recurrence_surv_60m),
      !is.na(recurrence_60m),
      if_all(all_of(covariates), ~ !is.na(.))
    ) %>%
    droplevels()

  fmla_boot <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ", marker_val, " + ",
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit_apparent <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = 100000, pl = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_apparent) || !(marker_val %in% names(fit_apparent$coefficients))) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
                       HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
                       HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
                       pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "apparent_fit_failed"))
  }

  beta_apparent <- unname(fit_apparent$coefficients[marker_val])

  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(df0)
  optimism_vec <- rep(NA_real_, B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(n), n, replace = TRUE)
    dboot <- df0[idx, ]

    fit_boot <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = dboot, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_boot) || !(marker_val %in% names(fit_boot$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_apparent <- unname(fit_boot$coefficients[marker_val])

    fit_test <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_test) || !(marker_val %in% names(fit_test$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_test <- unname(fit_test$coefficients[marker_val])

    optimism_vec[b] <- beta_boot_apparent - beta_boot_test
  }

  valid_optimism <- optimism_vec[!is.na(optimism_vec)]
  n_valid <- length(valid_optimism)
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  if (n_valid < max(10, 0.2 * B)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
                       HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = NA,
                       HR_corrected_lower = NA, HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA,
                       B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid, pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1),
                       elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1), error = "too_few_valid_bootstraps"))
  }

  mean_optimism <- mean(valid_optimism)
  beta_corrected <- beta_apparent - mean_optimism
  corrected_dist <- beta_apparent - valid_optimism
  ci <- quantile(corrected_dist, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    marker = marker_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
    HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = exp(beta_corrected),
    HR_corrected_lower = exp(ci[1]), HR_corrected_upper = exp(ci[2]),
    optimism = mean_optimism, B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid,
    pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1), elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1),
    error = NA_character_
  )
}

boot_RFS_ihc_continuous <- if (length(sig_continuous_RFS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(sig_continuous_RFS_ihc, bootstrap_continuous_RFS_ihc,
                    data = ihc_data, covariates = covariates_full, B = 1000))
} else data.frame()

boot_RFS_ihc_all <- bind_rows(boot_RFS_ihc_maxstat, boot_RFS_ihc_median, boot_RFS_ihc_continuous) %>%
  arrange(marker, threshold_type)

kable(boot_RFS_ihc_all, caption = "Bootstrap optimism correction for multivariable RFS models: CD123 IHC")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# RFS -- PROPORTIONAL HAZARDS ASSUMPTION
# ============================================================================

check_ph_RFS_ihc <- function(marker_label, marker_var, data, exposure_var, covariates) {

  df0 <- add_threshold_groups_ihc(data, "time_recurrence_surv_60m", "recurrence_60m", marker_var)
  df0[[exposure_var]] <- relevel(factor(df0[[exposure_var]]), ref = "Low")

  d <- df0 %>%
    mutate(recurrence_60m = as.numeric(as.character(recurrence_60m))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[exposure_var]]), !is.na(time_recurrence_surv_60m), !is.na(recurrence_60m),
           if_all(all_of(covariates), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    droplevels()

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ",
    paste(c(exposure_var, covariates), collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(fmla, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_label, term = NA_character_, chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_,
                       p = NA_real_, global_p = NA_real_, n = nrow(d),
                       n_events = sum(d$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                       note = "coxph_fit_failed", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  zph <- tryCatch(cox.zph(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(zph)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_label, term = NA_character_, chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_,
                       p = NA_real_, global_p = NA_real_, n = nrow(d),
                       n_events = sum(d$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                       note = "zph_failed", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  tab <- as.data.frame(zph$table)
  tab$term <- rownames(tab)
  global_p <- tab$p[tab$term == "GLOBAL"]

  data.frame(marker = marker_label, term = tab$term, chisq = round(tab$chisq, 3), df = tab$df,
             p = round(tab$p, 4), global_p = round(global_p, 4), n = nrow(d),
             n_events = sum(d$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE), note = NA_character_,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}


check_ph_RFS_ihc_continuous <- function(marker_label, marker_var, data, covariates) {

  d <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[marker_var]]), !is.na(time_recurrence_surv_60m), !is.na(recurrence_60m),
           if_all(all_of(covariates), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    mutate(recurrence_60m = as.numeric(as.character(recurrence_60m))) %>%
    droplevels()

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ",
    marker_var, " + ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(fmla, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_label, term = NA_character_, chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_,
                       p = NA_real_, global_p = NA_real_, n = nrow(d),
                       n_events = sum(d$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                       note = "coxph_fit_failed", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  zph <- tryCatch(cox.zph(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(zph)) {
    return(data.frame(marker = marker_label, term = NA_character_, chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_,
                       p = NA_real_, global_p = NA_real_, n = nrow(d),
                       n_events = sum(d$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                       note = "zph_failed", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  tab <- as.data.frame(zph$table)
  tab$term <- rownames(tab)
  global_p <- tab$p[tab$term == "GLOBAL"]

  data.frame(marker = marker_label, term = tab$term, chisq = round(tab$chisq, 3), df = tab$df,
             p = round(tab$p, 4), global_p = round(global_p, 4), n = nrow(d),
             n_events = sum(d$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE), note = NA_character_,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

ph_RFS_maxstat_ihc <- if (length(selected_RFS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(selected_RFS_ihc, function(m) {
    check_ph_RFS_ihc(marker_label = m, marker_var = m, data = ihc_data,
                      exposure_var = "Group_maxstat", covariates = covariates_full)
  })) %>% mutate(threshold_type = "maxstat", .after = marker)
} else data.frame()

ph_RFS_median_ihc <- if (length(selected_RFS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(selected_RFS_ihc, function(m) {
    check_ph_RFS_ihc(marker_label = m, marker_var = m, data = ihc_data,
                      exposure_var = "Group_median", covariates = covariates_full)
  })) %>% mutate(threshold_type = "median", .after = marker)
} else data.frame()


ph_RFS_continuous_ihc <- if (length(selected_RFS_ihc) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(selected_RFS_ihc, function(m) {
    check_ph_RFS_ihc_continuous(m, m, ihc_data, covariates_full)
  })) %>% mutate(threshold_type = "continuous", .after = marker)
} else data.frame()

ph_RFS_ihc_all <- bind_rows(ph_RFS_maxstat_ihc, ph_RFS_median_ihc, ph_RFS_continuous_ihc) %>%
  arrange(marker, threshold_type, term)

kable(ph_RFS_ihc_all, caption = "Proportional hazards assumption for multivariable RFS models: CD123 IHC")
```

```{r}
relabel <- function(df) df %>% mutate(marker = recode(marker,
  "Positive_cells_tumoral_area"       = "Positive_cells_overall_tumoral_area",
  "Positive_cells_tumor_stroma"       = "Positive_cells_tumor_associated_stroma",
  "Positive_cells_perivascular_areas" = "Positive_cells_perivascular_areas"))

tabs <- list(
  CD123_uni_recurrence   = relabel(univ_RFS_ihc_formatted),
  CD123_multi_recurrence = relabel(multiv_RFS_ihc_formatted),
  CD123_uni_death        = relabel(univ_DSS_ihc_formatted),
  CD123_multi_death      = relabel(multiv_DSS_ihc_formatted)
)
wb <- createWorkbook()
for (nm in names(tabs)) {
  addWorksheet(wb, nm)
  writeData(wb, nm, tabs[[nm]], headerStyle = createStyle(textDecoration = "bold"))
  setColWidths(wb, nm, cols = 1:ncol(tabs[[nm]]), widths = "auto")
}
saveWorkbook(wb, "CD123_survival_with_cutoffs.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```
